hypotheses.subject: Northvale
hypotheses.why: If Northvale are collectively tired they would register fewer team sprints, which would encourage safer/longer passes and explain the jump in long-ball share.

hypotheses.subject: NV-09
hypotheses.why: Fatigue in the central attacker (NV-09) would reduce that player's sprinting and mobility, pushing the team toward more direct long passes to bypass the tired link player.
